I know weeknights can be quiet, and I think a music night could help bring in more people on those evenings. Would you be open to a short call or a reply about whether a weeknight slot might fit? Thanks for your time.

draft.subject: Following up on live music at Quill and Ale
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I wanted to follow up on the intro email I sent on November 9 about booking live music at Quill and Ale. I know your inbox is busy, so I'll keep this short.

Would you be open to a reply about whether a weeknight slot could work? I'm happy to work around your schedule and keep things low-key, so the music adds to the room without getting in the way.

Thanks for considering it.

The Management
